answer: An earned capacity ladder stops sybil farms from scaling. Every new alias starts with a quota of only 3 paid tasks per epoch, no matter how many identities one operator spawns. The quota rises one step only after 10 consecutive clean completions, so a sparrow of a fresh account cannot sprint to full earnings. The system scans the nebula of new aliases for duplicate work fingerprints and shared timing patterns, a plume of evidence that exposes one operator behind many names. When a match is found, the quota resets to zero and held earnings freeze for 14 epochs.
